reading.body:
CyrusOne's OCB1 data center in Council Bluffs, Iowa, provides 9 MW of IT capacity across 420,000 square feet, a footprint that points to multi-tenant enterprise use rather than a dedicated AI training build.

The certifications listed, PCI DSS, HIPAA, FISMA, TIA-942, and HITRUST, signal readiness for payment, healthcare, and federal workloads. They do not indicate which tenants occupy the facility or whether any AI compute runs there.

For AI scaling, 9 MW is a small power increment, and the low ratio of power to technical space is consistent with general-purpose colocation. The data includes no address, nearest airport, or announced expansion, and the suitability score of 56 rests only on published IT capacity and operator type, so it cannot show whether this site will grow into a larger AI role.

suitability.basis: weighted mean of the published inputs named here, scaled to 100; formula on the methodology page
